label: Finding-84
title: nl-offline: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: The phrasing mirrors Insurance Business, which does not list Overheid.nl: The claim's structure ("took its own site offline as a precaution, as did ...") matches Insurance Business, whose list is DigiD, MijnOverheid, the House of Representatives, Port of Rotterdam, KNVB and hospitals. Overheid.nl comes from Reuters (RTE, factbox; Mashable and Wikipedia cite Reuters), one origin. | Restoration not recorded: ncsc.nl (08:19:19Z) and overheid.nl (08:19:27Z) both returned HTTP 200 with normal content on 22 Oct; BBC says the Dutch cyber agency "is now running again". impact.json gives no end time.
